## Terms

### Monitoring Agent

- **Monitoring Agent** · self — The Monitoring Agent is a legacy component: Cloud Manager documentation marks it removed, while Ops Manager documentation marks it end-of-life for Ops Manager 4.4 and directs users to the MongoDB Agent. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/cloud-manager/tutorial/start-or-stop-monitoring-agent.md
